plan.window_order: oldest to newest, including observation date
plan.test: observation and target both in 2026; completed daily closes only
representations: relative: close/latest-1 for all 100 closes, predict next/latest-1
plan.scaler: StandardScaler fit on train only for each representation
plan.selection: lowest 2025 validation MAE in won among 10 learned candidates; no refit; compare winner to persistence before any test scoring
plan.deployment: show learned winner and persistence side by side even if winner loses; recommendation based on validation only
plan.boundary_policy: exclude row when observation and target cross partition boundary; early input history may precede partition
plan.random: random past case selection only, recent 10 observation sessions with known next close
